Republic of the Philippines DEPARTMENT OF THE INTERIOR AND LOCAL GOVERNMENT DILGNAPOLCOM Center, EDSA comer Quezon Avenue, West Triangle, Quezon City http: //www.dilg.com.ph OILG OPINION NO. 33 MAYOR JOSEPH A. EVANGELISTA 04 JUL 2019 Office of the City Mayor Kidapawan City Province of Cotabato Dear Mayor Evangelista: S. 20Z This has reference to your letter dated 18 December 2018, requesting the Department's permission to allow you to use the remaining Calamity Fund to be utilized in the acquisition of drug testing kits for High School and College students of Kidapawan City. While this Department is cognizant Of the noble intention of your request, we cannot allow you to utilized the remaining/unexpended balance of your Local Risk Reduction and Management Fund (formerly termed as Local Calamity Fund) for any purpose other than what is provided in Republic Act No. 10121, otherwise known as the "Philippine Disaster Risk Reduction and Management Act Of 2010% NDRRMC-DBM- DILG Joint Memorandum Circular No. 2013-011, dated 25 March 2013 and COA Circular No. 2012-002, dated 12 September 20122. The said law and issuances are very explicit that the unexpended balances of the Local Risk Reduction and Management Fund shall accrue to a special trust fund solely for the purpose of supporting disaster risk reduction and management activities of the Local Disaster Risk Reduction Council (LDRRMC) within the next five years. Thus, on the assumption that the remaining calamity fund pertains to 2018 fund, your request is not permissible as the same is in contravention of the above-mentioned law and issuances. Entitled, "ALLOCATION AND CHYLIZATION OF THE LOCAL DISASTER RISK REDUCTION AND MANAGEMENT FUND (LDRRMF)" 2 Entitled, "ACCOUNTING AND REPORTING GUIDELINES FOR THE LDRRMF OF LOCAL GOVERNMENT UNITS, NATIONAL DISASTER RISK REDUCTION AND MANAGEMENT FUND (NDRRMF) GIVEN TO LGUs AND RECEIPTS FROM OTHER SOURCES"

Nevertheless, please be informed that, if still the unexpended LDRRMF is not fully utilized after five years, the same shall revert back to the general fund and will be available for other social services to be identified by the local sanggunian3. We hope to have addressed your concern accordingly. Very truly yours, By Authority of the Secretary: C. SACENDONCILLO, CESO 111 Undersecretary CC: Dir. Josephine C. Leysa Regional Director DILG-Region XII Section 21, RA No. 10121
